title: Data Constraints
$comment: Data constraints, one file each under `data_types/constraints/`: the physical limits a value is declared within, an element a type names by reference. One kind, `data_constr`, which an application type names as its `data_constr_ref`. The directory is mandatory and may be empty.

name.description: The data constraint's identity; the file is named from it (`data_types/constraints/{name}.yaml`, or a suffixed name when another file collides case-insensitively) and is never what identifies it. Unique across the data constraints, must not be blank, and immutable; an element of another layer may carry the same name.

min.description: The lower physical limit; omitted or `null` when there is none. An integer is held as the integer it is; NaN and ±Infinity are refused.

max.description: The upper physical limit; omitted or `null` when there is none. An integer is held as the integer it is; NaN and ±Infinity are refused.

level.description: The rule's `CONSTR-LEVEL`, the category of the constraint (the lower the level, the more stringent the check); omitted or `null` when the rule states none.

description.description: Free text about the data constraint. Written into the generated ARXML as the element's `DESC`, exactly as held; the empty default writes none.

package.description: The one sub-package of `/DataTypes/Constraints`, its layer's package, this data constraint is emitted in, a single SHORT-NAME segment: the data constraint and every reference to it take `/DataTypes/Constraints/{package}/`. Absent means `/DataTypes/Constraints` itself. It is held to the AUTOSAR Identifier rule.
